defect.cause: A malformed persisted repeater array containing null rows caused TypeError in list, tabs, accordion, dropdown, gallery, and carousel rendering. The renderer accessed nested properties before verifying each row was an object.

reproduction.result: Before the fix: TypeError reading href, text, or assetId from null during Canvas/public rendering.

defect.fix: Normalize the in-memory display list to plain object rows, replacing malformed/null/array entries with empty objects before rendering. Existing localized safe defaults and media-empty UI then render without mutating the Page Model.
defect.savePublish: No persisted Page Model data is rewritten; Save remains a private draft action and Publish remains separate.

reuseReview.used: The existing shared authoredNodeHtml renderer, existing content schema, safe display defaults, and existing Chromium lifecycle fixtures.
reuseReview.externalCode: None; no compatible external solution was needed for this local renderer guard.
reuseReview.dependency: No new dependency, paid service, or infrastructure.

tests.coverage: Null repeater rows for list, tabs, accordion, dropdown, gallery and carousel; safe fallback output; malformed nested content assertions from the preceding renderer fix.

tests.environment: Used the existing prepared dependency directory through a temporary local symlink; no dependency was installed or changed.

tests.coverage: Real Chromium Canvas/Inspector draft Save, reload, separate Publish, plus gallery/crop/source-switch parity at 390px and 1366px.

testEnvironmentNote: The initial Chromium invocation was blocked before test assertions because the sandbox disallows the local loopback test server. The same command was rerun with approved loopback access; all five real-browser tests passed. An initial typecheck attempt without dependencies failed with `tsc: not found`; rerunning against the pre-existing temporary dependency symlink passed.
